notes.title: The retro adventure begins NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389497/f227415ce4c480156a9779b2696489501c11c880.png[/img]

[b]Adventurers, the time has come![/b]

[i]The Illuminati call upon their loyal minions! They need your strength to fulfill their desires. This means one thing: [u][b]HATONE is officially released[/b][/u]! It’s time to test your mettle![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389497/e67a578f888229f5e46cc369655ad5cdde89d1ac.png[/img]

I’m a solo developer. I strive to create dynamic games with action battles and awesome music! HATONE is my first creation, and I’ve poured my soul into it. Learning game development from scratch wasn’t easy, and even when setbacks arose—like losing a publisher and delaying the release for over a year—I refused to give up.

Thank you to everyone who supported me during this journey—and to everyone who supports the game now! Your kindness and encouragement mean the world to me. And I’m not stopping here—I’ll keep developing games and learning how to make them better and better!

[b]HATONE awaits you![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389497/79b7291af743447f7a906fd9c28c144a378362b7.png[/img]

[i][b]With love,
The developer of HATONE[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389497/8509cd877a7fbbf0be1c49316c0463fc19db6c6f.png[/img]

notes.title: The Wait is Over: HATONE Launches on April
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389497/9e543a33aa255e8945e58977f292632488526d8d.gif[/img]

Hello, adventurers!

HATONE is my love letter to retro gaming with easter eggs from old-school games and just a hint of modern gameplay! I’m thrilled to share some exciting news with all of you who have been patiently waiting for HATONE to come to life. I can finally announce the official release date of the game:

📅 Release Date: on April 15 (PST), April 16 (CET), 2025

This has been an incredible journey for me as a solo developer, and now the finish line is in sight. It’s hard to put into words how much your support and encouragement have meant to me over the past years.

See you on launch day!

notes.title: Embark on a Captivating Journey with Oxygen Cocktail
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/fbaebec06b09be66bfa54c183f114fd7bdcd007c.gif[/img]

We are delighted to announce the upcoming release of [b]Oxygen Cocktail[/b], an immersive open-world visual novel game set to redefine your gaming experience. On November 16th, dive into a world where exploration seamlessly intertwines with storytelling, creating a unique adventure shaped by your choices.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/ef11f3d16a22a5ad597bf1e11cfdbc860270b5e4.gif[/img]

[b]Oxygen Cocktail[/b] invites players to embark on an enchanting odyssey, seamlessly blending the freedom of open-world exploration with the immersive storytelling of a visual novel. Set in a picturesque rural village, the game beckons adventurers to unravel its secrets, forge meaningful connections with captivating characters, and navigate a narrative that dynamically responds to each choice. The aesthetics of [b]Oxygen Cocktail[/b] are a masterpiece in themselves, combining isometric pixel art with various styles, creating a visually stunning and unforgettable landscape. As players traverse the charming village and its surroundings, they are accompanied by an immersive soundtrack that enhances the overall atmosphere, adding a layer of depth to the gaming experience. With a launch date set for November 16th and an exclusive 10% discount for early enthusiasts, [b]Oxygen Cocktail[/b] promises a truly unique and captivating gaming journey.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/96e088e2b9242b6dd51feea6f0bf99a60d6dcda7.gif[/img]

Don't miss the chance to embark on this extraordinary journey at a limited-time discounted price. Wishlist today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2352410/Oxygen_Cocktail/

notes.title: Iron Dungeon: A Roguelike Action Adventure Unveils Its Launch Date
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/f04cdeb45806f663071ac4257586bb1dab3712a2.gif[/img]

The highly-anticipated game, ​Iron Dungeon, is set to captivate gamers worldwide as it announces its official release date of October 3, 2023, at 2 PM EDT. Developed by ​R​_Games, Iron Dungeon promises an unparalleled gaming experience that combines the best elements of roguelike, platformer, and twin-stick shooter genres.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/?utm_source=steampost

Iron Dungeon is a thrilling amalgamation of genres that will immerse players in a challenging underground world filled with danger, excitement, and relentless action. Players will assume the role of combat clones tasked with exploring a mysterious underground military complex. Their mission: to find a way to the surface and uncover whether life still exists on Earth.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/b1575efd400a35af050b3f8d8b8250f6d628539f.gif[/img]

[b]Key Features of Iron Dungeon
[/b]

Roguelike Challenge: Iron Dungeon offers an exhilarating roguelike experience, with randomly generated levels that keep players on their toes. No two playthroughs are the same, ensuring endless replayability.

Platforming Precision: Navigate treacherous platforms, activate jump boosters, and demonstrate your precision and agility as you explore every corner of the complex.

Intense Twin-Stick Shooting: Engage in heart-pounding battles with hordes of enemies, using a diverse arsenal of weapons and gadgets. Dodge bullets, aim well and show your mettle in the face of danger.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/e20d82dedb38bf4dc8d02886d1c95d053d4c9020.gif[/img]

Exclusive Launch Discount: To celebrate the game's release, Iron Dungeon will be available for just $9.99 USD, with an enticing 10% discount for the entire first week. Wishlist today so you do not miss the discount. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/?utm_source=steampost
